newsitem.title: GERMANY: Sievert-Buba unlikely to reach M3 target this year.
newsitem.headline: Sievert-Buba unlikely to reach M3 target this year.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Olaf Sievert said on Tuesday the Bundesbank would probably not reach its 1996 target for M3 money supply of four-to-seven percent growth.

"One can of course not totally rule out the possibility that we reach the target corridor," Sievert said in a speech prepared for delivery at a conference. "We have experienced several surprises towards the end of the year in the past."
Sievert said the Bundesbank was relaxed about the current development of M3 as the basic monetary trend was right.
"The concept of monetary policy is geared to the medium term," Sievert said. It was never our aim to hit the spot exactly at the year-end by hook or by crook."
M3 slowed to an annualised rate of 8.4 percent in September from 8.7 percent in August.
